title: Solidify storage connector IaC: preflight validations, upgrade hooks, and health checks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Unify and harden the Terraform module that provisions block (EBS), file (EFS), and object (S3) storage for Private (VPC) deployments. Deliverables: i) preflight validation steps to catch unencrypted or mis-scoped resources before apply, ii) upgrade hooks and migration strategy for module major/minor bumps, iii) automated health checks (drift detection, snapshot integrity, lifecycle enforcement), and iv) gating rules to prevent non-compliant resources in customer VPCs.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes a preflight plan command that fails fast on: unencrypted buckets/volumes, public ACLs, missing lifecycle policies, or KMS misbindings
Upgrade hooks implemented as optional 'migration' submodule with documented runbooks and automated smoke tests
Automated health-check Lambda (or container) that runs daily and reports to Console SLO dashboard: snapshot age, failed snapshots, bucket lifecycle drift, EBS unattached older-than threshold
Module includes provider version constraints and a compatibility matrix (AWS provider + Terraform) and CI job that validates upgrade path for next two provider minor versions
PR validation pipeline rejects changes that remove encryption or reduce snapshot retention without an explicit migration plan
notes: Design decision: prefer least-surprise defaults (encryption enabled, private ACLs, explicit KMS key alias) to avoid customer opt-out footguns.
We will implement preflight checks using a small Go binary invoked by a null_resource before_apply; long-term plan to upstream checks to a provider-level preflight hook.
Snapshot management: snapshots created with tags referencing module version + resource id to enable safe garbage collection during migration.
Cross-account snapshot sharing is out-of-scope for initial rollout but must be supported by extension point in the module.
We will not automatically rotate KMS keys on upgrade; instead provide documented rotation playbook and automated verification steps.
comments: 2025-01-12 - Asha Patel: Initial spike completed. Prototype preflight binary catches unencrypted S3 buckets and EBS volumes in ~95ms on CI. Need to harden error messages for operators.

2025-01-20 - Mateo Gomez: Added migration hook draft. Migration steps include: 1) create new KMS key with alias, 2) re-encrypt S3 objects via copy/replace in a canary bucket, 3) snapshot EBS volumes, 4) gradual cutover using mount-and-verify. Posting runbook for review.
2025-01-28 - Security review (I. Chen): Flagged cross-account IAM permissions in snapshot module; requested least-privilege policy template and automated policy linter in CI.

2025-02-02 - SRE (Priya Rao): Proposed daily health-checks to produce Prometheus metrics: storage_snapshot_failures, bucket_lifecycle_drift_count, ebs_unattached_old_count. We'll wire alerts for snapshot failures > 5/day.
2025-02-05 - PM review (L. Martinez): Approved P0 migration plan for customers on older module versions; asked to include opt-in toggle for automatic snapshot retention extension.
